incidents.name: Unverified 0xAC899Ef6 business-logic flaw
incidents.notes: The closed-source contract pays out its USDT balance against an input it never validates, so a flash-loaned call drained it in a single transaction.

sources.ref: onchain review: victim 0xAC899Ef647533E0dE91E269202f1169d7D47Ae92 created 2022-08-25T09:08:44Z by 0xde60871cb51500d0a959dc8412feef14f5e68281, unrelated to attack sender 0xab90a897cf6c56c69a4579ead3c900260dfba02d; no EIP-1967 Upgraded events, age measured from deployment. Loss verified onchain: 5,955.47 USDT left the victim to 0x25d3e7e85108d03b0e778c4b5853b02206871d72 in the exploit transaction.
